# CLAIM 1: the set {x odd: first p valuation letters = u} is ONE residue class mod 2^{B_u+1}:
# equivalently, same p-block => x = x' mod 2^{B_u+1}.
def word_of(x,p):

        y=3*x+1;b=0
        while y%2==0:y//=2;b+=1
        w.append(b);x=y
    return tuple(w)
